description: Huawei Cloud CES+AOM alarm noise reduction analysis skill. Analyzes CES (Cloud Eye Service) and AOM (Application Operations Management) alarm data, identifies high-frequency alarms, and generates noise reduction recommendations and optimization plans. Analysis covers four dimensions: alarm governance, alarm convergence, alarm correlation, and long-unresolved alarms. Supports core resource filtering and outputs an HTML optimization report. Use this skill when the user mentions 告警降噪, 告警优化, 告警治理, 告警收敛分析, 告警风暴, 告警太多, 告警数据分析, CES告警降噪, AOM告警降噪, 华为云告警, 告警分析报告, 生成告警报告, or needs to (1) analyze alarm data distribution and trends, (2) identify alarm types that need priority handling, (3) generate noise reduction strategies and recommendations, (4) output an HTML optimization report.
